breaking_changes.BC_description: Chalk now requires Node.js 4 or later, dropping support for older Node.js versions.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Upgrade to Node.js 4 or later to use Chalk v2.0.0. If you must continue using an older Node.js version, stay with Chalk v1.x.

breaking_changes.BC_description: The `chalk.hasColor()` method has been removed from the library.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Use the `has-ansi` package directly instead of `chalk.hasColor()`. Example: Replace `chalk.hasColor(string)` with `hasAnsi(string)` after installing and importing the has-ansi package: `const hasAnsi = require('has-ansi');`

breaking_changes.BC_description: The `chalk.stripColor()` method has been removed from the library.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Use the `strip-ansi` package directly instead of `chalk.stripColor()`. Example: Replace `chalk.stripColor(string)` with `stripAnsi(string)` after installing and importing the strip-ansi package: `const stripAnsi = require('strip-ansi');`

breaking_changes.BC_description: The `chalk.styles` property has been removed from the library.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Use the `ansi-styles` package directly instead of `chalk.styles`. Example: Replace `chalk.styles.red` with `ansiStyles.red` after installing and importing the ansi-styles package: `const ansiStyles = require('ansi-styles');`
